key.name: pomodoro-seconds
key.description: Length of one work interval in seconds. The preferences window edits this in whole minutes, from 1 to 180.

key.name: short-break-seconds
key.description: Length of the break that follows a pomodoro, in seconds.

key.name: long-break-seconds
key.description: Length of the break that ends a set, in seconds.

key.name: set-size
key.description: How many pomodoros are followed by a long break instead of a short one.

key.name: auto-start-breaks
key.description: Begin the next break as soon as the pomodoro is over.

key.name: auto-start-work
key.description: Begin the next pomodoro as soon as the break is over. Off by default: coming back to work should be a deliberate act.

key.name: sound-enabled
key.summary: Sound at the end of an interval
key.description: Play the theme sound when an interval finishes. The system event sound setting is respected as well.

key.name: toggle-keybinding
key.description: Global shortcut that starts, pauses or resumes the timer. Empty by default; the timer is driven from its panel menu until keys are assigned here.

key.name: skip-keybinding
key.description: Global shortcut that finishes the current interval early. Empty by default.

key.name: timer-state
key.description: Persisted state of the timer: IDLE, RUNNING or PAUSED.

key.name: timer-kind
key.description: Persisted kind of the current interval: POMODORO, SHORT_BREAK or LONG_BREAK.

key.name: timer-slot
key.summary: Consumed slots of the current set
key.description: How many pomodoro slots of the current set have already been consumed.

key.name: timer-end-wall-ms
key.description: Unix time in milliseconds at which the running interval ends, or zero when no interval is running.

key.name: timer-remaining-ms
key.description: Remaining milliseconds of the current interval, frozen while paused.

key.name: timer-started-wall-ms
key.summary: Wall-clock start of the current interval
key.description: Unix time in milliseconds at which the current interval was started, or zero when no interval is open.
